summary:
An explosion at a school in eastern Afghanistan killed at least seven students and wounded more than 90 people. Another account put the toll at 10 students killed and more than 100 injured. The blast occurred at 10 a.m. in the Andar Ser area on the outskirts of Asadabad, Kunar province. The Interior Ministry blamed carelessness at a nearby explosives depot, and an investigation is ongoing.

US aircraft fired precision munitions into the stern of the Pacific Archer after the ship attempted to run the US blockade of Iran's ports, and the Pacific Archer was disabled in the Gulf of Oman. The US said it would continue to strictly enforce the blockade. Kuwait summoned Iran's ambassador over a strike that killed two Italian technicians.

Spanish voters go to the polls on Sunday. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez urged voters on Friday to turn out in large numbers to prevent Spain from moving backwards as campaigning ended. Polls suggest his eight-year leftist leadership will end, and Santiago Abascal's Vox could become the first far-right party to join a Spanish government since the Franco era.

headlines.title: Explosion at Afghan school kills students, with conflicting tolls
headlines.summary: An explosion at a school in eastern Afghanistan killed at least seven students and wounded more than 90 people. Another account put the toll at 10 students killed and more than 100 injured.

headlines.title: US fires on ship breaking Iran blockade
headlines.summary: US aircraft fired precision munitions into the stern of the Pacific Archer in the Gulf of Oman after it tried to run the blockade of Iran's ports. Kuwait summoned Iran's ambassador over a strike that killed two Italian technicians.

headlines.title: Israeli strike kills two Doctors Without Borders staff in Gaza
headlines.summary: Doctors Without Borders said an Israeli strike killed two men who worked as security guards at its clinic in Gaza, calling it a direct hit. The Israeli army said it targeted Hamas terrorists, and the World Health Organization condemned the strike.

headlines.title: Canada's Supreme Court upholds Quebec ban on religious symbols
headlines.summary: Canada's Supreme Court on Friday upheld Quebec's ban on religious symbols for most public-sector employees, using a constitutional override. Rights groups warned that the ruling unfairly targets Muslim women and weakens legal protections for fundamental rights.

headlines.title: Spain votes Sunday as polls point to conservative and far-right gains
headlines.summary: Spanish voters go to the polls on Sunday, with polls suggesting an end to Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez's eight-year leftist leadership. Sanchez urged voters on Friday to turn out in large numbers to prevent Spain from moving backwards.

headlines.title: Measles deaths hit historic low in 2025, WHO says
headlines.summary: The World Health Organization said on Friday that global measles deaths hit a historic low in 2025, but millions of children still missed vaccinations. Outbreaks persisted in dozens of countries, and the WHO said progress on elimination had stalled.

headlines.title: KMT wins New Taipei but loses Taichung in Taiwan local elections
headlines.summary: Kuomintang candidate Lee Shu-chuan won the New Taipei mayoral race on Saturday, extending the party's 21-year leadership of the municipality. In Taichung, the KMT's Johnny Chiang Chi-chen lost to Democratic Progressive Party legislator Ho Hsin-chun, ending eight years of opposition rule there.

headlines.title: S&P keeps France at A+ but moves outlook to negative
headlines.summary: S&P on Friday kept France's A+ credit rating but changed its outlook to negative from stable, warning of a possible downgrade. The agency cited the country's struggle to bring down its budget deficit.
